attempts.summary: Created a "Fleet Internal CA" root CA on node1, issued a TLS server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2,IP:10.100.162.11) signed by that CA, deployed the cert/key to node2 and configured nginx to serve HTTPS on port 8443. Installed the CA certificate as a trusted system anchor (update-ca-trust) on both node1 and node2. Verified full chain trust via curl using each node's default OS trust store (no --cacert override needed) and via openssl s_client. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for both nodes with boot-id proof and post-restart re-verification of CA trust, cert files, nginx service, and HTTPS reachability.
